instruction: Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Read the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/final_benchmark.step, /home/user/Desktop/params.json. Complete the full FreeCAD Path/CAM delivery. Configure stock, Job origin, and fixture/check geometry; machine the outside profile, three pockets, sixteen through holes, two counterbores, and one surface region; use at least five tool classes. Tool rule: use at least five tool classes covering facing, pocketing, drilling, counterboring, surface finishing, and profiling. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-40.nc, /home/user/Desktop/post_log.txt.
